### 2. The "Last Mile" Challenge (The Distribution Transformer)
This is where your engineering ears will perk up. While the big high-voltage transmission lines are fine, the "neighborhood" level is where the strain happens. 
*   A standard home might draw 1 to 5 kW on average.

*   If four neighbors on the same cul-de-sac all buy EVs and plug them in at 6:00 PM when they get home from work, they could theoretically blow the local pole-mounted transformer, which wasn't sized for that kind of simultaneous load.

### 3. Managed Charging (The "Smart" Solution)
To solve this, engineers are moving toward "Managed Charging." Instead of the car charging the second it's plugged in, the utility company communicates with the charger.
